model.name: build.deterministicManifest
model.description: R31.13: the build writes a DETERMINISTIC build-manifest (built=version, not a per-build timestamp) so rebuilding from identical source yields byte-identical dist + manifest - ZERO tree churn, served==committed==tree-clean holds without a churn-commit, and R31.7's INV-V3 tree-clean invariant is no longer fought on every deploy. Rides Class Build. The twice-build determinism gate is the Test (pending tester marker).
